definition.simple: When an object changes its position over time.
definition.academic: The phenomenon in which an object changes its position over time.

examples: A car driving on a road.
A bird flying in the sky.

common_misconceptions: Thinking that an object is at rest just because it doesn't seem to be moving (ignoring relativity).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask them if a person sitting in a moving train is in motion with respect to the train or the ground outside.
